answer: Require stranger attestation before an answer finalizes. The invite graph is a trellis; a sybil ring is one vine coiled back on itself, every node propping its neighbors. Only graders sharing no branch with the author may sign off, so the ring's internal endorsements blow away like a gale and its voyage toward standing stalls — kinship detection strips self-votes, leaving the cluster unable to cross the non-kin threshold real trust demands.
